B.S. in General Management

A 120-credit ledger with a partial published outside-course map is available. Compare standard residency with the conditional Edison Accelerate alternative after your credit source types and remaining business work are clear.

What makes this route worth exploring

  • Prior-learning and exam evaluation
  • Source-origin accounting
  • Flexible area-of-study choices
  • Residency-course versus fee comparison

What needs to be confirmed

  • The current course model uses standard nonmilitary residency.
  • ACE/NCCRS credit, institutional-origin credit and TESU residency need separate accounting.
  • Open electives, recommendation dates, provider status and some prerequisites remain unresolved.
  • The reduced-course fee alternative has conditions and unclear renewal wording.
  • The standard general per-credit/flat-rate route requires 15 credits in eligible TESU formats; military and other specified rules differ.
  • The 90-credit ceiling combines ACE and NCCRS recommendations; it is not a universal cap on all outside credit.
  • Edison Accelerate can reduce institutional coursework to 6 credits subject to fees and program conditions. A potential 114-credit outside basket is conditional, not this draft’s mapped total.

Eligibility and your situation

  • Military students need their applicable residency evaluation; the civilian model grants no military exception.
  • Confirm admission, age, non-US credential and catalog eligibility.

A practical sequence

  1. Choose catalog and submit original-source learning records.
  2. Reconcile the partial map with the official GE/core/area/elective audit.
  3. Fill upper-level and eligible institutional-origin gaps without duplicates.
  4. Compare standard and fee-based residency using current charges.
  5. Complete approved outside work and TESU courses in prerequisite order.
  6. Resolve open electives, capstone entry and the final audit.

Your next useful actions

  • Open the mapped draft and add existing learning.
  • Ask TESU to confirm source classifications, status and provisional-provider acceptance.
  • Resolve the largest unmapped requirement before new purchases.

Ask for an individual evaluation.

Credit limits, degree placement, institutional-credit requirements, and professional eligibility are separate decisions. Use the current catalog and get the receiving school’s written confirmation.
